chapterInfo.content:
6
Onyankopɔn bu asase ne ɔman no atɛn
1Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 2#Hes 36.1; Mika 6.1 Onipa ba, fa w’ani kyerɛ Israel mmepɔ, na hyɛ nkɔm tia wɔn, 3na ka sɛ: Mo Israel mmepɔ, montie AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛ mmepɔ ne nkokoɔ, nsubɔnhwa ne mmonhwa nie: Hwɛ mede nkrantɛ mereba mo so mabɛsɛe mo sorɔnsorɔmmea, 4#Lew 26.30 na mo afɔrebukyia adane afo, na wɔabubu mo aduhwam adum no, na mama mo atɔfoɔ agugu mo abosom ahoni anim, 5na mede Israelfoɔ afunu magu wɔn abosom anim, na mabɔ mo nnompe apete mo afɔrebukyia ho ahyia. 6Mo tenabea nkuro nyinaa bɛdane amamfo, na sorɔnsorɔmmea no bɛdane ahodwirideɛ, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mo afɔrebukyia adane afo ne ahodwirideɛ, na wɔabubu mo abosom ahoni asɛe no, na wɔatwitwa mo aduhwam adum, na wɔagu mo nneyɛɛ no. 7Na atɔfoɔ bɛhwehwe ase mo mu, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.
8 # Yes 6.13 Nanso mɛgya mo mu ebinom a wɔbɛfiri nkrantɛ ano aka, amanaman mu, berɛ a wɔbɛbɔ mo apete nsase soɔ no. 9#Deut 30.2 Na mo mu nnipa a wɔbɛfiri mu afire no, bɛkae me, amanaman a wɔafa wɔn nnommum kɔ hɔ no mu, sɛ mabubu wɔn adwamammɔ akoma a atwe afiri me ho, ne wɔn ani a ɛdi wɔn abosom akyiri adwamammɔ mu no; na wɔn ara wɔn ho bɛyɛ wɔn nwunu, nnebɔne a wɔayɛ, wɔn akyiwadeɛ nyinaa mu no ho. 10Na wɔbɛhunu sɛ mene AWURADE; ɛnyɛ ɔkwa na maka sɛ mɛyɛ wɔn bɔne yi.
11Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Bɔ wo nsam, na fa wo nan pempem fam, na ka sɛ: Ao, Israel fie akyiwadeɛ bɔne nyinaa nti wɔnnue, sɛ wɔbɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ne ɛkɔm ne owuyadeɛ ano. 12Deɛ ɔwɔ akyirikyiri bɛwu owuyadeɛ ano, na deɛ ɔbɛn nso bɛtɔ nkrantɛ ano, na deɛ waka ne deɛ wɔakora no no bɛwu ɛkɔm ano, na m’anibereɛ bɛwie wɔn so. 13#1 Ah 14.23 Na mobɛhunu sɛ mene AWURADE, sɛ wɔn atɔfoɔ bɛdeda wɔn abosom ahoni ntam, atwa wɔn afɔrebukyia ho ahyia, nkokoɔ a ɛkorɔn nyinaa so ne mmepɔ atifi nyinaa ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa ase ne adum akusukusuu nyinaa ase, deɛ wɔhye hɔ aduhwam ma wɔn abosom ahoni nyinaa no. 14#Hes 6.7 Na mɛtene me nsa atia wɔn, na mɛyɛ asase no afo ne ahodwirideɛ asene Ribla serɛ so, wɔn tenabea nyinaa mu, na wɔahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.

Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Onipa ba, fa w’ani kyerɛ Israel mmepɔ, na hyɛ nkɔm tia wɔn, na ka sɛ: Mo Israel mmepɔ, montie AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn ka kyerɛ mmepɔ ne nkokoɔ, nsubɔnhwa ne mmonhwa nie: Hwɛ mede nkrantɛ mereba mo so mabɛsɛe mo sorɔnsorɔmmea, na mo afɔrebukyia adane afo, na wɔabubu mo aduhwam adum no, na mama mo atɔfoɔ agugu mo abosom ahoni anim, na mede Israelfoɔ afunu magu wɔn abosom anim, na mabɔ mo nnompe apete mo afɔrebukyia ho ahyia. Na atɔfoɔ bɛhwehwe ase mo mu, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.
Nanso mɛgya mo mu ebinom a wɔbɛfiri nkrantɛ ano aka, amanaman mu, berɛ a wɔbɛbɔ mo apete nsase soɔ no. Na mo mu nnipa a wɔbɛfiri mu afire no, bɛkae me, amanaman a wɔafa wɔn nnommum kɔ hɔ no mu, sɛ mabubu wɔn adwamammɔ akoma a atwe afiri me ho, ne wɔn ani a ɛdi wɔn abosom akyiri adwamammɔ mu no; na wɔn ara wɔn ho bɛyɛ wɔn nwunu, nnebɔne a wɔayɛ, wɔn akyiwadeɛ nyinaa mu no ho. Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Bɔ wo nsam, na fa wo nan pempem fam, na ka sɛ: Ao, Israel fie akyiwadeɛ bɔne nyinaa nti wɔnnue, sɛ wɔbɛtotɔ nkrantɛ ne ɛkɔm ne owuyadeɛ ano. Deɛ ɔwɔ akyirikyiri bɛwu owuyadeɛ ano, na deɛ ɔbɛn nso bɛtɔ nkrantɛ ano, na deɛ waka ne deɛ wɔakora no no bɛwu ɛkɔm ano, na m’anibereɛ bɛwie wɔn so. Na mobɛhunu sɛ mene AWURADE, sɛ wɔn atɔfoɔ bɛdeda wɔn abosom ahoni ntam, atwa wɔn afɔrebukyia ho ahyia, nkokoɔ a ɛkorɔn nyinaa so ne mmepɔ atifi nyinaa ne nnua frɔmfrɔm nyinaa ase ne adum akusukusuu nyinaa ase, deɛ wɔhye hɔ aduhwam ma wɔn abosom ahoni nyinaa no. Na mɛtene me nsa atia wɔn, na mɛyɛ asase no afo ne ahodwirideɛ asene Ribla serɛ so, wɔn tenabea nyinaa mu, na wɔahunu sɛ mene AWURADE.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
